title: Bounded receive slice 4: graph closure validation and selected task-snapshot accounting
outcome: Bounded receive slice 4: graph closure validation and selected task-snapshot accounting
acceptance: Commit and tree structure is validated (header, parents, tree types, names, modes, order, duplicates, bounded optional headers and tree depth) with complete commit-parent/root-tree/blob closure
Ancestry depth is the longest DAG path; gitlinks stay opaque and never trigger a fetch; supplied tags are parsed and bounded without new network targets
Selected-task bytes are charged per document occurrence across the explicit incoming/common-base/local snapshot set, with per-document and aggregate limits; a shared blob cannot evade output limits
No task path is materialized before the snapshot set and profile are admitted
